Appearance:
 Shri Harshit Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rajeev Upadhyay - Public Prosecutor for respondent/State.

Order 
1. This is first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C filed by the applicant who is apprehending her arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. RCT/143/24 pending before the JMFC, Bhind for the offence punishable under Sections 182 (wrongly mentioned as Section 185 of IPC) 195, 211 of IPC.

2. It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that applicant is a lady aged 33 years and was complainant/prosecutrix in a case vide Crime No.28/2019 registered at Police Station Ater, District Bhind.
She filed a written complaint for commission of offence by accused Amar Singh Baghel for offence under Sections 376, 506 of IPC.
On said case charge sheet was filed and trial conducted.

After completion of trial, Court came to the conclusion that present applicant as prosecutrix mischievously proceeded in the case against accused and later on resiled with the previous statements during investigation/trial Court under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and declared hostile.
Therefore, case was registered for offence referred above.

It is further 2 MCRC-21689-2024 submitted that case under Section 182/211 IPC would be made out in view of the judgment of learned Division Bench of Allahabad High Court in the case of Anil Kumar Rathore vs. State of U.P.
and others delivered on 17.01.2022 in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.6403/2021.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the above submissions and facts situation of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the application, therefore, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.

6. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following 3 MCRC-21689-2024 conditions by the applicant:-
1.
The applicant will mark his presence regularly before the concerned trial Court which has taken cognizance.
2. The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
3. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/ trial, as the case may be and shall not temper any evidence.

4 . The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be.
5. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused;
